titre: Catastrophes naturelles : dégâts totaux et part assurée
sous_titre: Monde, en Mds $, exercices 2024 et 2025 et moyenne des dix dernières années

2024.texte: In 2024, inflation-adjusted overall losses had totalled US$ 368bn, of which US$ 147bn had been insured.

2025.texte: damage amounting to some US$ 224bn was incurred, of which insurers covered around US$ 108bn

Moyenne 10 ans.texte: came in below the inflation-adjusted averages for the past 10 years (US$ 266bn). Insured losses mirrored the 10-year inflation-adjusted average of US$ 107bn
